audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart disagreed between layers: full phases[0..6].side was all "Skill" while content win[] and the packet levelChart both read Skill, Skill, Ahri, Ahri, Ahri, Ahri, Skill.
audit.why: Ahri holds a 53.64% win rate over 5412 games and owns levels 3 through first item; rendering "Skill" in one layer and "Ahri" in the other shows a paying user two answers to the same row.
audit.corrected: phases[2..5].side flipped to Ahri to match win[2..5], which are already Ahri. Rows 1, 2 and 7 stay Skill in both layers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text credited Mel's power curve to a "passive reflect shield" that scales, and named the source "Golden Sentence".
audit.why: Mel's passive is Searing Brilliance — bonus projectiles on the next attack plus Overwhelm stacks that execute at a threshold. There is no passive shield. The reflect is Rebuttal (W), a 38/35/33/29/26s cooldown ability, and Golden Eclipse is the R. The spike story is therefore backwards: Mel's late power is Golden Eclipse cashing Overwhelm at any range, not a scaling shield.
audit.corrected: Spikes rebuilt around Rebuttal's real cooldown (38s at rank 1, 26s at rank 5) and Golden Eclipse's 120/100/80s range-independent strike.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction was never stated: Rebuttal reflects projectiles, and Ahri's Q, W and R are ALL flagged projectile. Text said only "never poke while it glows".
audit.why: Orb of Deception, Fox-Fire and Spirit Rush's essence bolts are all projectiles, so Rebuttal turns a full Ahri combo back onto Ahri. Rebuttal also creates terrain and grants move speed but is not a dash — Charm's movement-stopping effect therefore has nothing to break, and Mel has no escape from a landed Charm. Rebuttal is 250 range and self-centred, so it cannot be used at poke range against her.
audit.corrected: Stated explicitly: bait Rebuttal with a single orb, commit inside its 38-second rank-1 gap; a landed Charm is a dead Mel because Rebuttal gives move speed, not a dash.

audit.whatIsWrong: Searing Brilliance's execute threshold and the auto-attack-reset burst tell were absent everywhere.
audit.why: Overwhelm stacks infinitely and consumes to execute, so Mel kills from a health bar that still looks survivable; her combo also opens with a bonus-projectile attack, which is the wind-up cue.
audit.corrected: Added to spikes[3], breakdown.feeding and whys[6].

audit.whatIsWrong: Mel was referred to as "his"/"he" throughout the full layer.
audit.why: Wrong pronoun on a live page reads as text written for a different champion, which is exactly what it was.
audit.corrected: Pronouns corrected in tldr, tradeGood, tradeBad, phases[0].why, phases[2].why, breakdown.wave and the matching report entries.

notes: Mel's kit was substantially fabricated in the content layer: 'Golden Sentence' does not exist (R is Golden Eclipse), and the repeated 'passive reflect shield' is actually Rebuttal (W). Mel's real passive, Searing Brilliance, is a bonus-projectile attack buff plus infinitely stacking Overwhelm that executes — a completely different threat that appeared nowhere. Mel was also written as male throughout the full layer. Level chart disagreed between layers on rows 3-6; fixed as an atomic group of four side flips (win[] was already correct). Not asserted, because the kit text cannot answer it: whether Rebuttal's reflection returns Spirit Rush's essence bolts at full damage, and whether Charm is cleansable/tenacity-reduced.
